notes.title: Steam Deck Update and Bug Fix
notes.content:
Welcome pilots,
Starship Scramble is now functional with Steam Deck and I will request a verification by Steam soon. A good new isn't it!

There have been a lot of bug fixes, including the wyrm boss.
Other graphical bugs in build mode are also fixed.
Audio setting no longer resets.
Update enemies' projectiles to be more visible.
The big ship has its camera zoomed out a bit, it will be more comfortable to see what is happening on screen.

Higher tier final bosses provide you extra 30s for fighting.
Tune Up slot machine has its algorithm changed to improve the variety of  tune-ups distribution.
Smooth ship rotation, more noticeable on Mouse usage. It should come to controller in the next small Update.

notes.title: Gameplay enhancement and feedback implementation
notes.content:
Most of the adjustments in this patch target at the ship building aspect:
[list]
[*] Show attack range of weapons.
[*] Stacking crews of the same job.
[*] Show effect of crews.
[*]Buying crews now has an effect to better indicate your action.
[*] Improve the tab navigation.
[*] Dragging to view crew no longer move the ship.
[*] Fix overlay issue in build mode.
[*] Reduce banishment options significantly.
[*] Guarantee shop to contain a connector for the first few waves.
[*] Add pictogram to differentiate connectors from other modules.
[*] Display an array of boss waves.
[*] Stock boost now scale with stars, the higher the star level is, the higher chance for the module to appear in shop. Non-upgradable is considered star 0.
[/list]

Most of these changes come from you feedback, keep them coming to make a better game!!
There are crucial notes, you should know about the gameplay changes:
[list]
[*] Ore fields have their color desaturated. 
[*] Touching a repair kit instantly use it.
[*] Scanned asteroids are no longer interactable.
[*] Crews are improvised, high tier crews cost a bit more.
[*] Adjust the victory scene to distinguish ship and crews.
[/list]

[h3]Core ship Changes: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix the starting weapon issue of Corsair ship.
[*] Nemesis has larger harvesting reduction, 
[*] Brawn starts negative defense, 
[*] Serenity earn less coin for each enemy alive.
[/list]

There are a lot of bug resolved in this patch and hopefully, you don't encountered an error!!

notes.title: Hot fix and small Balance
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix the localization errors,
[/list]
 There are small changes to the balance of the game, with the intension of creating a challenge for players:
[list]
[*] Late game cost is slightly increased.
[*] Enemies are also stronger at late game.
[*] Difficulty 1 is now always available, Difficulty 0 no longer has Tune-up mechanic to prevent overwhelming new players. 
[*] Modules and crews appearance rates are modified.
[*] Some melee weapons have their range effect lowered, especially Great star, Diamond Pickaxe, Acid Flail, Gravitational Tornado. 
[*] 
[*] Fire rate gained from crews are reduced.
[*] Journalist is moved from tier 2 to tier 3 and cost higher, there is a new negative passive compensate the immense power this crew brings, scaling remains the same however.
[*] Providence name is changed to Piggy, with a higher requirement for coin. Piggy does not have the passive of gaining 20% unused coin, and instead start with Wealth keeper.
[*] Wealth keeper no longer works after wave 20. 
[*] Meteorite Damage is adjusted to scale with wave and difficulty.
[/list]

The game now collects any crash and error event that occurs.
On the side note, Demo is also updated!! I found many players gave the demo a try first and it was not well-polished. 

Thank you for your time in Starship Scramble, the game is in active development, please let me know any concern you may have. Feedback and idea are also welcomed. 
Consider joining our discord server and create a better game. [url=https://discord.gg/zjdSveepgU]Starship Scramble Discord[/url]

notes.title: Starship Scramble Full Release
notes.content:
🚀 Get Ready to Scramble! Starship Scramble Launches [25 October,2025]! 🚀

🛠️ Build and Customize your starship with a variety of unique modules—from bizarre thrusters to powerful weapons—each with its own gameplay twist!

💥 Smash Through Waves of Enemies in intense, fast-paced combat where every ship configuration offers new ways to dominate the battlefield or escape from it!

🌌 Rescue survivors and have them contribute to your dangerous expedition. Together, push your way to safety, build houses and rebuilds the lost civilization. 

🎯 Strategize and Upgrade with an in-depth upgrade system that lets you fine-tune your starship to your playstyle. Research new modules and weapons with resources collected. Every decision matters as you scramble to survive and thrive!

Let's us launch to the stars. Be one of the first to pilot your own starship in Starship Scramble! 🌠

[b]Developer Note, [/b]

Thank you so much for taking your interest in my little indie game. Starship Scramble is my very first title, featuring an absurd amount of unique modules and weapons. I really put my heart in each and every one of them. 

This is also my first experience with bosses, there are a small number of them but in high variety. The exciting thing is they interact with all the terrain in the game, their projectiles destroy ore fields, creating an open and dangerous battlefield as the run is dragged on. They can be stopped by asteroids and borders. Some of them use borders as walkable paths. I also learned procedural animations to develop the two final bosses. 

One crucial mechanic I introduced to the game  is Tune-Up, game changing items that can be assigned into every weapon. Although they are quite complicated, they are extremely fun and satisfying when you manage to pull the trigger.

[b]Release Trailer[/b]
[previewyoutube=OSHPCgQ-uLY;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Update Note 1.0[/b]
[list]
[*] The majority of thrusters have been updated to introduce the third mechanic, alongside with providing weight support and movement speed. The mechanic is related to movement and skill, such as jet burn, leaving a trail of fire or special activation on using skill and much more.
[*]Minor UI improvement, smoother hover VFX.
[*]More instructions for the first play though.
[*]Readjust science points, killing bosses now reward crystal and science points, the value depends on the type of bosses.
[*]Some weapons now improve with star level.
[*]Endless options are available.
[*]Banish options, there are 5 free banish options and a free banish for each wave.
[*]Dash speed scales with the current movement speed of your ship.
[*]Adjust manual rotation and implement the initial rotation for all modules.
[*]Achievement rewards.
[*]Couples of new weapons and modules, most are unlockable from achievement.
[*]Fire weapons and magnetic weapons now have their own damage stats and unique scaling. Fire deals extra damage if the ship is in overheat state.

[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.7.5| Starship Scramble
notes.content:
Welcome pilots, 
With Starship Scramble Demo is out, there have been feedbacks and suggestions. A portion of the new content is directly available in the Demo!

The first implementation is the introduction of utility modules: lights and horns, the basic tools to ensure drivers safety that we surprisingly overlooked. These are not the only new modules; baits, turret boarding modules, mine dispensers and much more are included in this small update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485517/d56bbf305312f7495b9ee782cf667128ae76d625.png[/img]

Secondly, we have been updating technology for barriers, they now provide high damage resistance, connection slots and most unexpectedly, contact damage, which scale with Block stats(formerly Dodge). The further development led us to the new module, barrier activator. Which apply a passive to the barriers within 5x5 grid.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485517/d23e30d00b75a7db093b5a3b4a2ef2f55020f7a0.png[/img]

Moreover, stasis weapons are recently modified to distract enemies, a moment of the distraction is extremely value in such risky situation. The first ultimatum-class weapon also made an appearance in the game!!!.

On the less important notes, there are objectives to guide players with base-building.

Take care and build a cool ship.

notes.title: Starship Scramble Demo Launch
notes.content:
Welcome pilots, 
Today marks the start of our operation, Starship Scramble Demo is out now! It has been a challenge to develop the game solo, especially trying to make the game diverse. There are over 100 weapons, 100+ crews, 40+ tune-ups. They are really big numbers for a single dev.

Today is my birthday as well, I really hope to make a career in indie game development. I can't wait to hear what you all think of my first title.
[previewyoutube=pZVMJAkNLHI;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you so much for the support.

notes.title: Terror is approaching along with Starship Scramble Demo
notes.content:
Hi pilots, 
New threats on the horizon! two enormous Verge signals have been recently discovered! 
The first a worm-like creature with capability of splitting itself into smaller ones. The second one has three long legs and can unleash concentrated energy beam. Both are classified as catastrophic aka bosses.
 Furthermore, it appears with the emergence of the two giants, the high-threat Verge (mini bosses) has evolved to possess the ability to destroy ore field resulting in more open battle field as time progresses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485517/2e7a931911af86d2c78c44f61c91aabf03cfdf6d.png[/img]

This is a military secret, and any evidence of the experiment will be destroyed once the it is completed.

notes.title: Beta Update
notes.content:
Hi guys, I apologize for the lack of communication over the last 4 months. However I can assure that the game development has been steady and amazing. Lots of iterations in the existing game mechanic have been made, the store UI and ship building UI have been merged to create a more fluent gameplay. There are new bosses, elites and normal enemies that spread throughout the difficulty level.

The most important addition is the introduction of the settlement. Here, you put the resource gathered to good use, building houses for people you rescued, unlocking new starships and modules for the next exploration, finding any survivors still out there. They haven’t given up hope so do not give up on them!

notes.title: Tune Up Update
notes.content:
Greeting Pilots,

Tune-up has always been the core mechanic and a unique aspect of Starship Scramble compared to other survivor games. However, not many players actively use it. Therefore, I've made plans to work on new tune-ups that have a more visual impact to enhance their appeal and engagement. It is a HUGE change and a risky one, but I am ready to take it, especially, to ensure it works for all weapons(no promise). I have only completed 4/27 tune-ups but you can tell the fun and glitches are coming ːsteamhappyː
[previewyoutube=aPY2aabVAYg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Build Mode UI Update
notes.content:
Greeting Pilots,

This is  a devlog post, that I would like to update of content I have been working on recently. 
A fresh perspective's introduced to Build mode, with more visible options while minimizing the unnecessary components. This creates a conducive environment for our brilliant starship engineer.
Zoom feature and Screen moving have been introduced as requested by players. I assure you that these additions will greatly enhance your very gameplay experience.
[previewyoutube=lCKBiLo-8MY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What's other content has been taking time during February? [/h3]
A new way to play the game, Turrets, they are the selectable upgrade you can find in shop or randomly when you get a recruit. There are current 7 offensive turrets and 1 utility turrets and of course, they are distinct. There are more unique upgrades and crews coming to the game as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485517/d2740b857dffb51a5cccc6c88d100d63067ee702.png[/img]

Weapon's piercing and bouncing have received a minor change, they can be applied to any weapons with the help of certain crews or Premier Tune-up. Quantum weapons and Sonar weapons keep their innate piercing and bouncing but restricted. 

 Tune-Up is undergoing the third iteration, I am intending to revamp them to change how the weaponry function. For example, they can make weapons fire multiples projectiles, they can rotate around the weapons, logic tune-up that changes how an effect is triggered and you can even change the effect as well.

notes.title: Demo Update v.3 | New Enemies and Power
notes.content:
Greeting Pilot,

As Steam Fest is just around the corner, I have been occupied improving various aspects of Starship Scramble, and I am so excited to share with you. We start with new enemies and elites in the game. Particularly from wave 10 onward, one notable addition is Chomper, a robust adversary with high damage and hit points. Dealing with hordes of these enemies can pose a significant thread. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485517/6350cb22ea63bc0eae4bb1d8ef9c52f23095d496.png[/img]

To add an extra layer of excitement to the combat, I've incorporated elites into your regular waves, specifically appearing on waves 4, 7, and 11. These elites range from a pack of pepper hounds to an giant eggplant that provides a shield for the horde. Additionally, I've infused some playful references to the game's inspiration, introducing characters like Gunner Potato and Vampire Garlic. You might find these touch to be quite familiar and enjoyable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485517/ec185b570bb7d298e0ad05c96ab8ab5141693fab.png[/img]

Certainly, with new adversaries, comes new power. I've revamped the weapon system a bit, allowing you to apply piercing and bouncing aspect to any projectile-based weapons. Each adjustment applies these effects to all projectiles. In this demo, you can enhance piercing or bouncing attributes of weapons through premier tune-ups, exclusively available from the gacha machine. 
Moreover, artillery weapons have undergone a well-deserved change, enabling them to neglect contact with obstacles such as ore fields or asteroids.
For weapons possessing innate area-of-effect (AOE) attacks, their AOE radius now dynamically scales with the range stats, providing a more adaptable and effective impact.

Additionally, there are up to four new premier tune-ups available, which you can acquire if you hit the jackpot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485517/5ede497d954312b1b9a9435168ecc8ad3314ac09.png[/img]

There have been alterations to the crews, including the introduction of new sprites and the incorporation of unique crew members.

[b]A Little of Devlog Update[/b]
I have done couples of IRL playtesting and have improved the game experience via testers' response, that includes, power generation icon change, animation and effect in build mode and couples more.

I've also been dedicated to localization efforts, and the foundational elements for system localization are now in place. In future update, the game will support four languages, English, Vietnamese, Chinese and Spanish. If you are interested to see you language in the game, please contact me via the discord server.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485517/f91d4b9d5733a7677b12c9ce449936ec010b0ff3.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo Update v.2 | Accessibility and new movement
notes.content:
Greeting pilots!

I've noticed that a significant number of players are not enjoying the movement controls in Starship Scramble. To address this, I've made a crucial update introducing general controls using WASD for movement and the mouse for rotation. This change is aimed at simplifying the gameplay experience for many players. Additionally, you can now choose your preferred control scheme at the beginning of the game or adjust it in the options menu.

In terms of accessibility, basic options for gameplay, video, and audio have been added, allowing you to customize the game to your liking. If you have specific settings in mind, feel free to let me know in the community post or on our  [url=https://discord.com/invite/zjdSveepgU]Discord[/url] server.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485517/c0cb8024ab50f5eda3e793a30374ef37e18f8a5a.png[/img]

Let's talk about new stuff coming in this update. While testing, a friend of mine questioned about the animal crews he had chosen and expressed a desire to see them more involved rather than as idle images. I share his sentiment, and I'm sure many of you do too. I have been thinking of the issue ever since, this is what I got to show, EMOJIs. I dedicated extra time to develop emotes that showcase the personalities of the crews you've recruited. They appear when you got hit or win the wave and of course, you have the option of turn if off in setting. I really wish I could do more on this object, but Steam fest is just around the corner.

Have yourself an epic day,

notes.title: Demo Update v.1 | Quality Improvement and Gacha
notes.content:
Greeting pilots!

Starship Scramble has been out for a month and I have been reviewing every bit of gameplay footage available, and delving into comments and suggestions. This is first update for this demo and I want to polish the game experience to its fullest potential. By the way, if you find this game interesting, or want to share your idea of this game, consider joining our
▽Discord server▽
[url=https://discord.gg/zjdSveepgU]Discord Server[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485517/f9c4a6bff17a8522ae003a69b67537a036ec7325.png[/img]

[b]NEW FEATURE[/b]
Introducing the Tune Up Gacha, you have various way of acquiring the ticket needed to access this machine:
[list]
[*] Drop from killing enemies.
[*] Drop from scanning asteroid.
[*] 100% chance drop from killing loot enemies .
[/list]
A ticket is consumed for each spin. Results varies but all are Tune Ups and allow you to improve weapons at hand. Of course, you can store it for later and use it the original way.

Weapon Merge, 2 1-star same weapons become a 2-star weapon, simple!!! There are 4 tier of Merge and each star-up significantly and uniquely enhances the stats of the weapon, with the impact varying based on the specific weapon. With this mechanic, you will have more cause to spend all the precious coin you have earned, and especially with the burden of purchasing tune-up gone. 
Star-up mechanic is most automatically, however, you can force star-up by dragging a weapon and drop on the same weapon and star.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485517/5ede497d954312b1b9a9435168ecc8ad3314ac09.png[/img]

[b]LIFE-QUALITY CHANGE[/b]
Much and more has changed for the better, but let's see some of the highlight.
[list]
[*] Shop has been cleaned up to sell more modules you actually need!
[*] Some crews got a visual update to fit the aesthetic of the game, welcome Moo Bat, Monkey and new Mossy Bear.
[*] UI response to action, overheating, specialty, cast on cooldown now plays animations to indicate their current state.
[*] Couples of audio change and remove the loop sound in Menu.
[*] Melee attack will knock enemy back.
[*] Elite Health Bar.
[*] Asteroid Turret has been removed and asteroid drops from scanning includes repair kit, coin, chance for an escape ship, chance for Gacha ticket, chance for a chest of coin and finally chance that enemies showing up.
[*] You can close the Level up screen.
[*] Handling Modules are more flexible, you can double-click to instantly remove a module, you can perform swap right in build grid. 
[*] Power shortage and overloading now have a short animation showing their status.
[*] Mouse cursor and mouse actions tooltip are shown in build mode.
[*] More juicy visual effect(vfx) for taking damage. 
[*] Fixing bugs and fixing more bugs that are known!   
[/list]
